# Deal Profit

> Deal Profit surfaces price errors, penny deals, glitches and reselling
> opportunities as they are caught, and shares the live feed with its
> community on Discord.

## What this site is

A deal-alert site. Posts are pulled from a live Discord feed, and every deal
that carries a source link shows the retailer host plus the time it was
caught, so a reader can open the listing and check the price themselves.
Posts without a listing are labelled as such — the site never presents a
placeholder as a live deal.

## Pages

- [Home](https://goosiev.com/) — what the service is, how it works, latest finds
- [Deals](https://goosiev.com/deals) — the live feed, newest first
- [Upgrade](https://goosiev.com/upgrade) — premium membership: $25/month or
  $200/year, 7-day free trial, cancel anytime
- [Reviews](https://goosiev.com/reviews) — member reviews
- [Discord](https://goosiev.com/discord) — community server
- [Terms](https://goosiev.com/terms) — Terms of Service
- [Privacy](https://goosiev.com/privacy) — Privacy Policy
- [Refunds](https://goosiev.com/refunds) — Refund & Cancellation Policy

## API

- `GET /api/deals` — the live deal feed (JSON). Each item may include `url`
  (source listing), `retailer`, `price`, `referencePrice`, and `postedAt`.
- `GET /api/reviews` — approved member reviews.
- `POST /api/reviews` — submit a review (name, rating 1-5, text, category).

## Important notes for agents

- Deals are not guaranteed. Retailers correct prices and remove stock
  quickly; a post that is hours old may no longer be available.
- Prices shown are parsed from the linked listing at post time. Always
  confirm on the retailer's page before reporting a price to anyone.
- `/admin` is a private dashboard and is disallowed in robots.txt.
